identity_notes: Evening primrose oil (EPO) has an unusually focused, EPO-specific literature compared to most other identities in this screen -- the large majority of candidate records are genuine EPO trials or reviews, with comparatively little off-topic contamination (mainly a handful of agricultural/plant-physiology papers on Oenothera biennis cultivation and unrelated fatty-acid/prostaglandin theory pieces without primary EPO data). The largest reject bucket is broad, non-EPO-specific systematic reviews or clinical-evidence summaries (BMJ Clinical Evidence-style reviews of breast pain, PMS, chronic fatigue syndrome, pre-eclampsia; broad herbal-medicine-for-menopause/eczema/IBD reviews) where EPO is, at most, one of many treatments mentioned in passing with no EPO-specific extractable result visible -- these were rejected not_intervention in favor of the many dedicated EPO-specific reviews that ARE kept (e.g., 8721802/PMS, 23633319/eczema, 34200727 and 17509880/mastalgia, 33913585 and 34261202 and 36846678/cervical ripening, 39829189 and 41883983/menopause hot flashes, 38360611/broad EPO-only review). A recurring and clinically important route distinction is oral (swallowed) EPO versus VAGINAL EPO capsules used off-label for cervical ripening/labor induction (35440333, 36187740, 37102338, 37200751, 37468886, 38377980) -- these are flagged related_form_differs by route, and the cervical-ripening review-level records (33913585, 34261202, 36846678) likely pool both oral and vaginal studies without distinguishing them, which is noted explicitly. EPO's classic indications (atopic eczema/dermatitis, mastalgia, PMS, menopausal vasomotor symptoms, rheumatoid arthritis) show a genuinely mixed evidence base -- individual RCTs and meta-analyses skew toward null or modest effects for eczema and PMS specifically, while mastalgia and some skin-barrier outcomes show more consistent positive signals. One retracted publication (28742409, vitamin D+EPO in PCOS) was kept with retracted=True flagged and routed to handoff rather than silently discarded, since the brief's schema includes an integrity.retracted field precisely for this case.
